text:
Zoe: Quick check: compact ticks on the metrics chart are ambiguous when smoothing is active. Support sees '1.2k' and asks what unit / exact value is. Need a small, keyboard-friendly reveal. Aisha: Agreed. Proposal: abbreviated ticks by default, reveal full description in an accessible tooltip on hover/focus. SR should always get long form. Marcus: Implementation note: add data attributes with exact value and unit, then a tiny tooltip component reads them. Keep DOM minimal to avoid reflow. Keon: CSS/HTML sketch: ```html 1.2k
1,200 requests per minute
``` Aisha: aria recommendations: use aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip id, and fire an aria-live polite update on chart state changes: "Chart updated: smoothing enabled; y-axis unit: requests per minute." Also announce when a tick is focused: "Tick: 1,200 requests per minute." Zoe: Edge-case: mobile devices have no hover. Long-press should open the tooltip; also support a small persistent legend entry for units if device width < 420px. Marcus: Tests: add keyboard focus test for ticks, aria-live snapshot that includes unit + smoothing state, and visual snapshot for tooltip alignment. I'll add to chart.test.tsx. Keon: Accessibility nit: ensure tooltip contrasts meet 4.5:1 and respects prefers-reduced-motion for show/hide. Also make tooltip dismissible with Escape. Zoe: Action items: Marcus add tests + data hooks; Keon push CSS + reduced-motion; Aisha add SR copy to a11y checklist. I'll update the design token for tooltip BG. design-bot: Reminder Design review at 3pm PT. Please link PR with prototype.
